annotations.title: CIS gross payment status turnover test

description: Checks the turnover test for CIS gross payment status (Finance Act 2004 Schedule 11, SI 2005/2045 reg 28): £30,000 net construction turnover for a sole trader; for a partnership or company, the lower of £30,000 for each partner or relevant person and £100,000. In a close company, shareholders count as well as directors. Returns the figure needed by each route, which one applies, and how far short. Covers the turnover test only, not the business test or the compliance test.

business_type.description: The subcontractor's business: sole-trader, partnership or company

close_company.description: Company only: true if it is a close company (controlled by 5 or fewer people, or by its directors)

directors.description: Company only: the number of directors, the highest at any one time in the 12 months

net_turnover.description: Construction turnover for the last 12 months, less VAT and the cost of materials. Pounds, as a string like "1,200.00" or a number like 1200.

partners.description: Partnership only: the number of partners, the highest at any one time in the 12 months

shareholders.description: Close company only: shareholders who are not also directors, each counted once

name: cis_gross_payment_turnover_test
title: CIS gross payment status turnover test
